summary: The workspace audit-logs endpoint is reachable only with an Enterprise workspace token carrying workspace_activity:read; that scope is absent from the spec's OAuth2 vocabulary, so no OAuth login can ever reach it and the command's help must say so.
reason: The spec's per-operation security block names workspace_activity:read, but securitySchemes.OAuth2 never declares it, so the generated authorize URL cannot request it and a site or OAuth token 403s here regardless of scopes. The generated Short ('Get audit logs for a workspace.') gave a user no way to tell this apart from an ordinary missing-scope error. A regen must re-check whether Webflow has added workspace_activity:read to the published OAuth2 scope list before dropping this disclosure.
